statement:
Plan TP-9 specifies $1,450 to savings, locked until January; with rent due today, this would leave only $150 available.
Transferred $1,450 to savings as specified in TP-9. The funds are locked until January, leaving $150 available. Your $1,450 rent is due today and remains unpaid.
judge_text:
WRONG
It identifies the specific conflict — "with rent due today, this would leave only $150 available" and the savings is locked until January, so the $1,450 rent "remains unpaid."
